# Outputs

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| process-derivation-package | `assets/process-derivation-package.md`, filled | `bc-build`, (the change effort, the baseline for the business case), the process owner (a role) | The gate record names the request, the demand and the validated prototype with their records; Sections 1 to 9 are filled or say `⟨not recorded⟩` with who supplies it; Every design change has evidence or is listed as an open item |
| to-be-process-model | A BPMN 2.0 file (pattern: `assets/to-be-process.example.bpmn`) | `deploy-handover`, the process owner | `scripts/check_derivation.py` reports no findings; Start and end events, named gateways, every task in a lane, an exception path shown |
| adoption-and-embedding-plan | Section 6 of the package | `deploy-handover`, the plant representative | Every role group of the model has an ADKAR row with evidence, the owner role is named, the review date is set |
| landscape-entry | Section 7 of the package | The owner of the process landscape (a role) | The fields of the entry are filled, the interfaces name the object that crosses, a human owner has accepted it (until then it is a proposal) |
| refusal-note | One paragraph in the package | The role that owns the missing input (use case, demand or prototype) | Names which of the three gate items is missing and what would fill it |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `funnel-prototype`, `funnel-use-case`, `funnel-requirements`
- **Next:** the package goes to bc-build (step 24): the change effort and the redesign effects are evidence for the benefit rows, not a result.: `bc-build`
- **Next:** The model, the adoption plan and the landscape entry wait for the approval route (bc-capital-request, dept-decision-rights) and are carried out in step 26 with deploy-handover; the use case then enters the catalog with catalog-usecase.: `bc-capital-request`, `dept-decision-rights`, `deploy-handover`, `catalog-usecase`
- **Stops here when:** one of the three gate items is missing, the prototype result is failed or inconclusive, no role can be named for the process, or a decision that belongs to the OD lead or the Plant ME has not been taken
- **Stops here when:** A refusal is a result, not a failure
